text: dsh-expert-group 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的专家子代理协作插件。它向主代理提供角色化专家工具和任务分片 fan-out，并在 DSH 中加入任务侧栏与设置界面。用户可配置 explorer、librarian、oracle、designer、fixer 等角色，设置各角色模型与候补模型，并查看任务状态、接收完成或等待通知；插件还支持峰谷模型配置和可选的 Observer 视觉角色。适合需要把复杂工作拆给不同职责子代理、并集中跟踪执行的 DSH 用户。安装后可在插件设置中配置模型供应商与角色选项。

dsh-expert-group adds expert subagents to DSH. Assign tasks to roles such as explorer, designer, or fixer, or split work into fan-out shards. Configure role models and fallbacks, track tasks in a sidebar, and optionally enable a vision role.
想把复杂任务拆给不同专长的子代理并汇总处理
DSH 能不能让多个专家代理并行完成独立任务分片
我想给代码调查、设计和实现分别安排不同的代理
怎么在侧栏查看子代理任务的执行状态
希望为不同子代理单独选择模型并设置候补模型
主模型不可用时让专家自动切换候补模型
I want to delegate separate work shards to specialist agents in DSH
Let me choose models and fallback options for each expert role
dsh-expert-group 的功能「角色化专家代理」：插件注册 explorer、librarian、oracle、designer、fixer 等角色工具，按各角色职责执行只读调研、架构建议、视觉设计或已定方案的实现。
dsh-expert-group 的功能「分片 fan-out 委派」：主代理可通过 fanout 工具选择一个已启用角色，提交共享目标和多个独立分片；工具立即返回父任务标识，任务生命周期由 Host 管理。
dsh-expert-group 的功能「专家模型设置」：设置页允许配置角色模型、并发上限及超时等选项；还声明了通知开关与峰谷模型相关设置。
dsh-expert-group 的功能「根代理编排提示词」：启用设置后，插件向根会话系统提示词加入 orchestrator section，为主代理提供角色委派工作流。
dsh-expert-group 的专家代理需要宿主提供子代理与模型服务；仅安装插件并不能代替用户在设置页选择可用的模型供应商和角色模型。

dsh-expert-group README · dsh-expert-group：[English](README.en.md) | **中文**

本项目是deepseek harness(后续简写为dsh) 类omo-slim的子代理插件。主代理负责拆解任务、委派专家、整合结果与验证；插件提供可配置模型的角色化专家(每个专家都可配置候补模型和峰时谷时模型)、任务侧栏、模型配置、任务通知及会话删除等功能。
dsh-expert-group README · 安装：本插件发布到 npm 公共源，可直接用 npm 安装： ```shell npm i dsh-expert-group ``` 也可以在 DSH 的「添加插件」页面按包名安装：在输入框中填入 `dsh-expert-group`或索引，按需在右侧切换安装源，然后点击「安装」。

dsh-expert-group README · dsh-expert-group：[中文](README.md) | **English**

This project is a subagent plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), in the spirit of omo-slim. The parent agent decomposes tasks, delegates to experts, merges the results, and verifies them; the plugin provides role-based experts with configurable models (every expert can have fallback models and peak/off-peak models), a task sidebar, model configuration, task notifications, and session deletion.
dsh-expert-group README · dsh-expert-group：> This English edition is a translation of [README.md](README.md); if the two versions ever disagree, the Chinese version is authoritative.

dsh-expert-group README · Installation：The plugin is published on the public npm registry and can be installed directly:

```shell
npm i dsh-expert-group
```

You can also install it by package name from DSH's "Add plugin" page: enter `dsh-expert-group` (or an index) in the input box, switch the installation source on the right as needed, and click "Install".

dsh-expert-group README · Expert roles：| Role        | Purpose                                                        | Default permission boundary                    |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `explorer`  | Locate code, map symbols and existing patterns                 | Read-only                                      |
| `librarian` | Research external documentation and library APIs               | Read-only                                      |
| `oracle`    | Architecture trade-offs, hard problems, and code review        | Read-only                                      |
| `designer`  | Implement user-visible UI/UX work                              | Writable, constrained by task paths            |
| `fixer`     | Implement well-scoped multi-file changes and add tests         | Writable, constrained by task paths            |
| `observer`  | Analyze images, screenshots, charts, and PDFs                  | Read-only; vision support depends on the host  |

- **Notification events**: selects which events trigger notifications; all selected by default.

text: dsh-expert-group README · Expert subagent model configuration and management：**Automatic fallback limit**: when an expert's primary model fails, it automatically falls back to the candidate models (no fallback happens if no candidates are configured), and it stops once the fallback limit is reached; the default limit is 2. For example, set Fixer's primary model to deepseek-v4.1-flash, candidate 1 to glm-5.3-flash, candidate 2 to minimax-m3.1-flash, and candidate 3 to gpt-6-luna. With a limit of 0, the request fails as soon as deepseek-v4.1-flash fails; with a limit of 2, it tries up to minimax-m3.1-flash and then stops.

dsh-expert-group README · Expert subagent model configuration and management：- **Observer priority**: off by default. When enabled, images sent by the parent agent are forwarded to the observer subagent for image analysis, which is useful when the parent agent's model cannot accept image input. The observer subagent's model must support image input.
- **Per-role concurrency limit**: maximum number of concurrent runs for a single role.
- **Default role timeout**: maximum runtime of a single subagent session.
